searchText: My understanding is that "The Merge", as a discrete point, is more of an MVP of the move from PoW to PoS, and will not include sharding. The roadmap for "2.0" (apparently we're trying to get rid of that naming convention and replace it with just Ethereum again, w/ distinctions being made between Consensus (proof of stake) and Execution (creating new blocks) layer) includes sharding. That's supposed to be the next development goal after the merge. Sounds good!
